1028. Word Processor Operations

50

Medium

Problem Statement:
Create a word processor which could perform the following on a paragraph: Find the total number of words. Capitalize the first word of each sentence. Replace a given word with another word.
input_spec: The first line of the input is an integer C indicating the currently selected operation of the word processor. Below are the different operations that are available in the word processor: 1 - Find Paragraph length 2 - Capitalize the first letter of each sentence 3 - Replace a given word with another word The second line of the input consist of paragraph input with a maximum of 1000 words. Only for operation 3, the third line of the input will be given as two space-separated strings indicating the current word and the word that need to be replaced(all the occurrences).
output_spec: Print the paragraph after performing the selected operation C.
